functions.description: battle result party join/flag message state machine
functions.notes: Full shape, size and schedule match; the only diff is one scratch pair at +0x114..+0x13c: the progress pointer (zone+0x1840) gets r3 and the constant 1 for the two |= (1 << i) RMWs gets r2, the ROM has them the other way round. Levers that worked on the way down (UNDERGEN 1348 -> 16 -> 10): Party::IsBusy() as an int member reading state twice (state == 8 || state == 9) gives the ROM's mov #1/cmp/cmpne/movne #0; Member::HasPortrait() as a bool member stops CSE of the species bitfield, so the else arm reloads it; the 0x1840 sub-object read through a one-line int-cast inline (neighbour GetProgress style) keeps add #0x1840 + ldr #0xb48 unfolded; Battle::IsActive() getter with a local, assigned after the mask init, fixed the r1/r2 swap at +0x88; Container local before the GetTickCount() call fixed the step-3 order. Inert for the last 10 bytes (all compiled with pad/probe_cc.py): declaration order of every local (720 block-scope permutations, 400 random function-scope orders), progress as local/twice/inline/getter-with-local/two-definition/char*/int/struct-member spellings, 1u, bit locals, Bit()/WithBit() inlines, member Mark(), loop forms, field and counter types, a key local for (short)i, and colorsweep --budget 400 --depth 4. A 40-line toy with only the loop and the two RMWs gives the same r3/r2 every time, so whatever the ROM's source does differently is not local to these statements.
